description: Full official company profile of a French company by SIREN, from the French company registry (INSEE Sirene / INPI RNE): legal name, legal form, head office, NAF code (with its nomenclature, NAF 2025 code and status: GET /v1/lecture), workforce, officers, collective agreements (conventions_collectives, with conventions_collectives_notes reading out technical IDCC codes: 9999 means no collective agreement is assigned, it is not an agreement number to look up), VAT number, plus groupe_lei for LEI holders: the GLEIF level-2 group, direct and ultimate CONSOLIDATING parents (named, except a parent that GLEIF flags as a natural person or of an ambiguous legal form: mere_omise gives the reason, no name, no LEI; non_servie, a neutral value, when another reason leaves it out) or the declared reason for having none (accounting consolidation, never capital ownership or beneficial owners; sans_objet without a LEI). The core company data lookup for KYB and due diligence on France. An identity whose administrative status or legal category is missing in Sirene is served with blocs_absents (raison identite_incomplete) and a partial provenance. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a unit not proven to be a legal person is served with denomination null, counted in ecartes.diffusion_partielle. Paid via x402 ($0.005 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_profile

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French company profile (SIREN)
